Amid a brutal price war in the automobile industry, Chinese carmaker Geely has a plan to come out on top. Late last month, it formed a joint venture with Ford at the U.S. firm’s plant in Valencia, Spain, aiming to win over the European market by producing cars from both brands at a cheaper cost.
